text.en: 1. This Order is the Active Mobility (Shared Paths — Temporary Discontinuation) (MetaSprint Series Triathlon) Order 2026.
2. Each of the shared paths delineated by the black‑coloured line in the map set out in the Schedule is temporarily discontinued as a shared path from 6 a.m. to 12 p.m. on 29 March 2026.
